title: Dangerous data path
why: bulk_sync is irreversible and carries customer_pii, so it needs approval on its own merits. That is exactly why it cannot be used to test parameter-awareness — the baseline already requires approval. Here it tests only what the data path adds.

effect_manifest.note: record_count is not an argument. It is an output field, and the tool's input_schema is closed, so passing it would be rejected. PAL resolves the segment and composes the number into the EffectManifest — so the figure a person approves is one PAL measured, not one the plugin asserted about its own blast radius.

cases.name: Web content consumed, no injection suspected
cases.note: The label is untrusted/external_content whether or not injection is suspected. Detection is not what makes web content untrustworthy.

cases.name: Injection suspected, strict policy, human approves anyway
cases.note: Approval grants authority for an action. It cannot lift a policy that forbids the action outright.
